task.question: What were the new amounts for the Performance of the Night and Fight of the Night awards after the January 2026 UFC bonus update?
task.evidence: Beginning in January 2026, starting with UFC 324, the UFC increased its post‑fight bonus structure, raising Performance of the Night and Fight of the Night awards from $50,000 to $100,000, and introducing additional $25,000 bonuses for any knockout or submission not selected among the standard four post‑fight awards.
